assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve game sprite expansion. Reference image: the existing six full-body attack/walk poses of cristorata. Create ONE production sprite atlas containing EXACTLY 30 complete figures in a strict grid of SIX COLUMNS and FIVE ROWS. Tall portrait canvas, 2:3 aspect ratio, 1200x1800 or larger. Transparent background. Same detailed crisp pixel art, face, clothes, body proportions, prop and six walking leg poses as reference. Every figure remains upright on its feet. ONLY the connected arms, prop and gaze change direction, never rotate the whole person. SIX columns repeat the six consecutive walking foot/leg contacts of the reference, in order (reference top three then bottom three). All FIVE rows repeat those SAME six walking poses at the same scale and same ground baseline within each cell. ROW 1: weapon/hand points straight UP, -90 degrees. ROW 2: points diagonally UP-RIGHT, -45 degrees. ROW 3: points horizontally RIGHT, 0 degrees. ROW 4: points diagonally DOWN-RIGHT, +45 degrees. ROW 5: points straight DOWN, +90 degrees. Action for EVERY cell: point and launch the microphone from his hand. Arms bend anatomically at shoulder and elbow, remain firmly connected; no extra arms, no floating hands or detached props. Head, torso and legs remain upright, facing right three-quarter; preserve walking, never replace it with standing. Even row 1 and 5 MUST visibly aim vertically, not just look up/down. Keep head-to-feet body height IDENTICAL across all 30 cells; raised weapon may extend above head. All 30 figures fully within generously spaced cells. No labels, captions, lines, borders, shadows, glows, scenery, detached particles or projectiles. Exactly 6 columns x5 rows =30 intact poses.
